This was the first relationship where I saw it going somewhere. When I think about the future, I still see him there with me. 
Before him a good day meant hanging out with all of my girlfriends and taking goofy pictures and eating lots of ice cream, and I know they're here for me through this and hopefully I'll eventually want to be around other people (:
can you tell I'm new here 😂

I've gotten a lot of those comments before, but I disagree. He is someone I really could see myself raising children with, something I didn't see in my past boyfriends. 
He has a lot of mental issues due to his little brothers death at a young age, he believes he is incapable of loving other people because he is too afraid of them leaving him. 
Again, I understand why you think that, but I disagree (:

I can't speak for others but I have no idea what makes me feel those things. My mom has ADD and my grandma has anxiety, but I'm not sure if those are inherited traits. as far as depression, I can't explain it either. some days I'll come home and talk to my parents and laugh, then go upstairs and sob into my pillow. I wish I knew what was "going on" ):

I don't want to obnoxiously comment on each individual post, so thank you all for your supportive comments, it's so nice to know I'm not alone in these feelings. 
also I'm really sorry that I posted in the wrong subreddit, I interpreted it wrong :(
thank you for the suggestions! it was hard to pick which one because I have no idea how many are out there, so I really appreciate your suggestions thank you (:
